verification_gaps.summary: The verification record was stale relative to repair round 2 and did not independently establish the final diff.
verification_gaps.evidence: The artifact still recorded pre-repair focused, live PostgreSQL, full-suite, and build results.
verification_gaps.impact: Final acceptance would have relied on implementer claims rather than authoritative evidence for the lock-first repair.
verification_gaps.recommendation: Refresh the artifact with final focused, PostgreSQL, CI, full-suite, and production-build results.

do_not_change.summary: Keep the first ordered candidate-source read and PostgreSQL share lock before any release mutation.
do_not_change.evidence: The first transaction statement selects the candidate Signal/Run in running state and applies FOR SHARE on PostgreSQL; runBatch guarantees statement ordering.
do_not_change.impact: A terminal transition either happens before the lock and prevents release, or waits until the release and successor graph commit together.
do_not_change.recommendation: Retain the first-statement placement and interleaving regression.
